description: Lets the agent open a public Cloudflare quick tunnel to this machine and read back the live trycloudflare.com address. Exposes the host to the internet, so it ships OFF — grant per agent with care.
skill_summary: How to expose this machine over a public Cloudflare quick tunnel and report the address: call start_tunnel to launch it and get the URL, get_tunnel_url to re-read the current URL/status. Load when the user asks to 'start a tunnel', 'expose the app', or 'give me the public URL'.
